name: markdown-sql-lint
description: Live PostgreSQL syntax checking for ```sql code blocks in Markdown files — psql meta-commands (\d, \dt) and prompts understood. Powered by the real PostgreSQL parser (libpg_query).

markdownSqlLint.enable.description: Enable linting of SQL code blocks in Markdown files.

markdownSqlLint.fenceLanguages.description: Code fence info strings treated as SQL (case-insensitive).

enumDescriptions: Recognise psql meta-commands (\d, \dt staff, \c ...) and prompts; flag unknown or mistyped commands.
Recognise psql meta-commands and prompts; never flag them.
Pure SQL only: every psql meta-command or prompt is an error.
markdownSqlLint.psqlCommands.description: How to treat psql meta-commands and prompts inside SQL blocks.

markdownSqlLint.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after typing stops before re-linting.

markdownSqlLint.rules.keywordCase.description: Suggest a capitalization style for SQL keywords (shown as a suggestion, never an error).

markdownSqlLint.rules.requireSemicolon.description: Suggest terminating statements with a semicolon.

markdownSqlLint.rules.discourageSelectSt.description: Suggest listing columns instead of SELECT * (off by default: SELECT * is normal while exploring a schema).
